title: Wendy D NDE 20780
content: I had had surgery a week before. I developed an infection, and had a bleeding vessel in my abdomen. Suddenly, I began to bleed. I had been in pain for quite some time before this event, but at the time, I was not feeling any discomfort. I was an inpatient at the hospital at the time. I heard the nurse saying my blood pressure, and hearing the numbers go down. She said, ‘I can't get a pulse or blood pressure, we're losing her!’ I watched the nurses pack gauze into my wound, and run to get blood, twenty-two units. It wasn't frightening at all. I felt regret thinking I would be leaving my family and friends behind.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I nearly bled outMany cancer surgeries.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I can't recall thinking I had a physical form. I was looking at it from outside of it.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was awake. I could hear and see everything.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning They say I was hallucinating and talking to people that weren't there for a couple of days while I was in the intensive care unit.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I knew some of them, not others. They seemed to know me. No spoken words, just a supportive feeling presence.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I felt no pain or discomfort. I had no real sense of a physical body.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Curiosity; a feeling of regret to leave family, as I am convinced they need me.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I felt that I wasn't ceasing to be, but that I was going to the source of all things.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: No best, no worst. It just was.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: It wasn’t as monumental and scary as I would have thought.
